notes: Hiphil was requested as "make sick; vex; irritate", but the only attested hiphil form (Job.16.3, יַּמְרִיצְךָ, "what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?") means "embolden", matching the lexicon's own "embolden" sense rather than "vex/irritate" -- confirmed with the person and shipped as "embolden; spur on" instead.

Trimmed "be grievous/painful" pairing to "be grievous" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: 1Kgs.2.8/Mic.2.10 show a grievous/painful curse and destruction -- "grievous" and "painful" are synonyms of that one sense; "be severe" (Job.6.25, "forcible words") is genuinely distinct and stays.
Trimmed hiphil's "embolden; spur on" to "embolden" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: both describe the one Job.16.3 citation -- synonyms, not two senses.
